Archery
Expertise with using bows to hunt and kill.
Skill Type:
Combat Skill
Max Level:
90
Requirements:
None
Skill Trainers:
Elahil
,
Alravesa the All-Hunter
,
Floxie
“
SWISH... THWANG!
— An Arrow
Archery Overview
Archery
is a combat skill often learned by many across
Alharth
. A basic skill used by hunters, farmers, and warriors alike, Archery focuses on providing ranged attacks that can cover a wide area.
In-Game Description
Expertise with using bows to hunt and kill.
Training Archery
An old rumor suggests that Archery was one of many skills taught on the Island of
Anagoge
, once home to a Council Academy. Travelers whisper of a magical bow empowered with the ability to instantly teach the skill of Archery to anyone who successfully finds it.
Elahil
is
Serbule
's resident Bowyer & Fletcher. For a price, he can train travelers in the basics of Archery.
Alravesa the All-Hunter
is willing to teach experienced Archers more advanced techniques. Found in the remote Town of
Amulna
, Alravesa will help her friends unlock Levels 51-60 and 61-70 of Archery. She is also willing to teach advanced abilities to those willing and able to learn them.
Floxie
in the
Fae Realm
unlocks Archery Skill Levels 71-80 and teaches level 70+ abilities.
Levels 81-90 are unlocked by
Emersil the Ever-Gloating
deep beneath
Povus
.
Connected Skills
Sub-Skills:
None
Secondary Skills:
Fletching
- The craft of arrow-making. This crafting skill is generally picked up by any Archer wanting to produce their own
arrows
.
Related Skills:
Alchemy
- The corrosive
Acidic Cleaner
series of alchemical liquids is often used in
Fletching
, so Archers interested in crafting arrows should study this skill.
Carpentry
- A skill that goes hand-in-hand with Fletching, and produces some materials required by
Fletching
.

lists: An old rumor suggests that Archery was one of many skills taught on the Island ofAnagoge, once home to a Council Academy. Travelers whisper of a magical bow empowered with the ability to instantly teach the skill of Archery to anyone who successfully finds it.
ElahilisSerbule's resident Bowyer & Fletcher. For a price, he can train travelers in the basics of Archery.

Alravesa the All-Hunteris willing to teach experienced Archers more advanced techniques. Found in the remote Town ofAmulna, Alravesa will help her friends unlock Levels 51-60 and 61-70 of Archery. She is also willing to teach advanced abilities to those willing and able to learn them.
Floxiein theFae Realmunlocks Archery Skill Levels 71-80 and teaches level 70+ abilities.
Levels 81-90 are unlocked byEmersil the Ever-Gloatingdeep beneathPovus.
Fletching- The craft of arrow-making. This crafting skill is generally picked up by any Archer wanting to produce their ownarrows.
Alchemy- The corrosiveAcidic Cleanerseries of alchemical liquids is often used inFletching, so Archers interested in crafting arrows should study this skill.
Carpentry- A skill that goes hand-in-hand with Fletching, and produces some materials required byFletching.
